identity_contract: semantic prompt IDs and prompt lineage; no per-frame optimal rematching

numeric_contract.invalid_output: Raise ValueError; never report passing parity for invalid arrays.
numeric_contract.masks: Finite boolean or numeric 0/1 arrays; validate before boolean conversion. Per-track shape (H, W), backend shape (N, H, W).
numeric_contract.scores: Finite values; NaN and infinity are rejected before evaluation or archival.
